items.question: How can I cancel my reservation?
items.answer: You can cancel for free up to 24 hours before the service. Between 12h and 24h, 50% will be charged. Less than 12 hours, the full amount will be retained.

items.question: Does the driver wait for me at the airport?
items.answer: Yes, our driver will be waiting for you in the arrivals hall with a sign with your name. We monitor your flight to adjust in case of delay.

items.question: What are the payment methods?
items.answer: We accept cash, debit/credit cards, MB Way and advance bank transfer.

items.question: Do the vehicles have Wi-Fi and water?
items.answer: Yes, all our vehicles are equipped with free Wi-Fi, bottled water and USB chargers for your comfort.

items.question: What is your operating area?
items.answer: We operate throughout the national territory and Spain, with special focus on Lisbon, Porto and Algarve.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: With this Privacy Policy, provided pursuant to Article 13 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 ("GDPR"), we wish to inform the User about the ways in which his/her Personal Data (i.e., any information that can directly or indirectly identify him/her) will be processed when he/she visits, registers, and/or purchases services on the www.way2go.pt website and associated mobile applications (hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Platform").
This policy, together with the Cookie Policy and the General Terms of Use and Conditions of Sale, establishes the basis on which Users' personal data will be processed.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.content: The Data Controller of the personal data collected through the Platform is:
list: Way2Go
Email Address: privacy@way2go.pt

sections.title: 2. Categories of Personal Data Processed
sections.content: When you interact with the Platform, make a booking, contact support, or create an account, we process the following categories of personal data:
list: Identification, Contact, and Login Data: First and last name, email address, telephone number, and account login credentials.

Booking and Service Data: Detailed information regarding the requested transport/ride, pick-up and drop-off locations, dates, times, assigned driver details, and customer support interactions aimed at improving service delivery.
Billing and Payment Data: Tax and accounting information (VAT number/Tax ID, billing address, company name if applicable), and financial/payment card details required to process transactions.

Geolocation Data: Real-time geographical coordinates of the User's and driver's devices, strictly processed to ensure the safe, accurate, and efficient execution of the transportation service (identifying pick-up location, confirming customer on board, and completing the trip).
Navigation and Usage Data: IP addresses, browser types, operating systems, navigation flows within the Platform, system logs, and performance indicators.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of Processing and Legal Bases

subsections.title: A. Contractual Performance and Legal Obligations
list: Platform navigation, account registration, and user profile management.
Processing, managing, billing, and executing transportation and mobility service contracts.
Customer care, technical support, and managing user inquiries, reports, or complaints.
Fulfillment of statutory, tax, and accounting obligations applicable to Way2Go's operations.
subsections.legalBasis: Legal Basis: The necessity for the performance of a contract to which the User is a party or for pre-contractual steps (Art. 6.1.b of the GDPR), and compliance with legal obligations to which the Data Controller is subject (Art. 6.1.c of the GDPR).

subsections.title: B. Legitimate Interest
list: Conducting aggregated statistical analysis to optimize Platform features and improve service quality.
Preventing and detecting fraudulent or harmful actions, ensuring system security, and defending Way2Go's legal rights.
Sending transactional communications (e.g., abandoned cart reminders or operational service updates).
subsections.legalBasis: Legal Basis: The legitimate interests pursued by Way2Go (Art. 6.1.f of the GDPR).

subsections.title: C. User Consent
list: Direct Marketing and Profiling: Sending commercial emails, updates, and tailored promotions based on user preferences and behavioral clusters.
Geolocation Activation: Real-time tracking for customers outside the strict requirements of active ride execution depends on permissions granted via device settings or the Platform interface.
subsections.legalBasis: Legal Basis: The User's explicit consent (Art. 6.1.a of the GDPR). Providing data for these purposes is strictly optional and consent can be withdrawn at any time.

sections.title: 4. Data Retention Period
sections.content: Personal data will be processed and stored only for the duration necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected:
list: Contractual and Tax Data: Retained for the duration required by applicable commercial and tax statutes (typically up to 10 years in accordance with legal statutes of limitation).
Account Data: Maintained as long as the User account remains active. Upon a deletion request, data will be erased or anonymized within a maximum of 3 months, subject to any overriding legal hold.
Geolocation Data: Processed and stored for a maximum period of 4 months from collection, unless further retention is required for legal defense or active complaint resolution.

Marketing and Profiling Data: Retained for 24 months for marketing and 12 months for profiling from the date of consent or the User's last active interaction (e.g., opening a newsletter), unless consent is revoked earlier.

sections.title: 5. Data Recipients
sections.content: To ensure the correct delivery of services, Way2Go may share personal data with:
list: Authorized internal personnel from administrative, commercial, and technical support departments.
Third-party service providers acting on behalf of Way2Go (e.g., payment gateways, cloud hosting services, IT infrastructure providers, and dispatch drivers/transport partners executing the ride).
Competent administrative, tax, or judicial authorities when required by law or necessary for legal protection.

sections.title: 6. International Data Transfers
sections.content: Personal data is processed and stored primarily within the European Economic Area (EEA). If auxiliary technical tools require transferring data to third countries outside the EEA, Way2Go guarantees that the recipient country ensures an adequate level of data protection or that the transfer is governed by Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission (Art. 46 of the GDPR).

sections.title: 7. Rights of Data Subjects
sections.content: Under the GDPR, Users have the right to request from Way2Go:
list: Access and Rectification: The right to inspect their personal data and correct inaccurate or incomplete details.
Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): The right to request data deletion when it is no longer required for its original purpose or when consent is withdrawn.
Restriction and Objection: The right to restrict certain processing activities or object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.
Data Portability: The right to receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, the User must submit a signed request via email to: privacy@way2go.pt. Users also maintain the right to lodge a complaint with their local Data Protection Supervisory Authority.

sections.title: 8. Security Measures
sections.content: Way2Go implements appropriate technical and organizational security measures (including data encryption, HTTPS protocols, and SSL certification) to safeguard personal data against unauthorized access, accidental alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.title: 1. Object
sections.content: These terms regulate the private transfer service provided by Way2Go.

sections.title: 2. Reservations
sections.content: Reservations must be made at least 12 hours in advance. Last minute reservations are subject to availability.

sections.title: 3. Cancellations
sections.content: Free cancellations up to 24h before. Between 12h-24h 50% fee. Less than 12h no refund.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device to improve navigation.

sections.title: 2. How we use
sections.content: We use technical cookies for the functioning of the site and analytical ones for visit statistics.
